entries.label: t08_01
entries.text: Montenevera is a town with lotsa snow and lost\nsouls. But lately, the concerts are a real draw too!

entries.label: t08_02
entries.text: The fluttering snow! The flickering candlelight!\nEvery day is like a festival here! Don’t you think?

entries.label: t08_06
entries.text: The Snow Slope Run is popular these days. You\ncan try it out on Glaseado Mountain!

entries.label: t08_08
entries.text: Isn’t Snorunt cute? Only the females have a\nchance of evolving into Froslass.

entries.label: t08_20
entries.text: It’s cold again today. I’ll have something spicy to\neat to warm me up!

entries.label: t08_22
entries.text: Do you know about the ultimate class of\nsandwiches? They’re called “Master” sandwiches,\r\nand no one seems to know the recipes for them.

entries.label: t08_23
entries.text: Everything tastes better when you eat outside!

entries.label: t08_26
entries.text: The Gym Leader here used to be Tyme, but she\nretired a year and a half ago. Her sister Ryme is\r\nthe Gym Leader now.

entries.label: t08_28
entries.text: Have you ever seen one of Ryme’s concerts? Her\nmusic shakes you right down to your soul!

entries.label: t08_29
entries.text: The stage lights up purple for the Gym Test! It’s\nso pretty!
